image-desc-custom: Deploy any XVA image from a URL you provide, over HTTP or HTTPS, plain or gzipped. Pick this if you host your own build.
image-desc-ronivay: A third-party community build of Xen Orchestra from source. Not maintained by this project or by Vates. Pick this if you already use it or prefer its packaging.
image-desc-vates: The appliance published by Vates, the company behind Xen Orchestra. Requires registration, and paid plans unlock more features and vendor support. Pick this if you want commercial support.
image-desc-xoa-hl: Xen Orchestra built from source by the XCP-HL project, not by Vates. No registration or subscription, all features unlocked. Updates from the XCP-HL repository. Pick this if you are not sure.
verify-ssl-certificate: Verify if ssl certificate is valid
